name: Frankie Knuckles
hook: A New York DJ whose five years at one Chicago club gave an entire genre its name.
blurb: Born in the Bronx, Knuckles moved to Chicago in 1977 to DJ at a club called the Warehouse. He mixed disco and European electronic records into all-night sets, from 1977 to late 1982, and record shops started getting requests for "that Warehouse music", shortened to house music. That is where the genre's name comes from, and it is unusually well documented for a dance-music origin story. His lasting importance is as the DJ whose taste and mixing style got a whole sound named after a building. The drum machine came later, at his next club, the Power Plant. He also produced and remixed a great deal, including early work with the singer Jamie Principle.

signatureTracks.title: Your Love (with Jamie Principle)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: A Knuckles/Jamie Principle collaboration that circulated on cassette and reel-to-reel for years before its wider release, mapping how house records spread before they were even pressed.
